title: TokenScale: Timely and Accurate Autoscaling for Disaggregated LLM Serving with Token Velocity
technique: autoscaling for PD-disaggregated serving driven by a Token Velocity metric + Convertible Decoders that absorb prefill bursts

optimized_metrics.evidence: TokenScale improves SLO attainment from 50-88% to 80-96% and reduces costs by 4-14% over state-of-the-art systems
reduces costs by 4-14% over state-of-the-art systems
applying rapid scaling for prefillers to meet TTFT SLOs while precisely managing decoders to sustain TPOT SLOs
applying rapid scaling for prefillers to meet TTFT SLOs while precisely managing decoders to sustain TPOT SLOs

headline_claim.text: TokenScale improves SLO attainment from 50-88% to 80-96% and reduces costs by 4-14% over state-of-the-art systems, including DistServe, BlitzScale, and AIBrix.

metric_definitions.definition_quote: This metric represents the maximum number of tokens that the instance can release in a second with the current allocated resource, for identifying the resource bottleneck of the system.
metric_definitions.notes: autoscaling signal, not a performance metric; separate prefill/network/decode velocities

metric_definitions.definition_quote: Time-to-First-Token (TTFT) and Time-Per-Output-Token (TPOT) characterized by the execution of the prefill and decode phases. The latter two evaluate the system's interactivity and the fluency of output generation, respectively.
metric_definitions.notes: no formal definition of queueing inclusion

metric_definitions.definition_quote: The TPOT SLO is fixed at 100 ms across all cases.
metric_definitions.notes: attainment computation (joint TTFT and TPOT?) not explicitly defined

slo_spec: TTFT by input length: 250 ms (<256 tokens), 400 ms (<1024), 2000 ms (up to 8192); TPOT fixed 100 ms; following prior work and MLPerf
load_regime: trace replay (Azure Conv/Code, BurstGPT, mixed), rescaled to ~22 RPS average; bursty traffic
tradeoff_acknowledged: SLO attainment decreases slightly when fewer GPUs are used (Fig 9 sensitivity)
hardware: NVIDIA A100 and H100 GPU clusters, NVLink, RDMA
models: Llama and Qwen of various sizes and TP degrees
extractor_notes: Objective is joint: SLO attainment up and GPU cost down; TTFT/TPOT SLOs are the thresholds that define attainment. Could alternatively be read with SLO_ATT as sole objective and COST as the efficiency target.
